source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Connect BMC Dedicate port
2. Check BMC netwrok and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB "lan print" and check if BMC has only one Bounded LAN chanel
3. Remove BMC Dedicate port, check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"
4. Plug BMC dedicate port , check BMC network and MAC from Web UI and IPMI OOB command "lan print"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BMC should have same network configuration inculde IP and MAC in three senarios
2. BMC network should work in three scenarios

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this checks the dedicated NIC keeps one bound LAN channel across three scenarios (connect, remove, replug) of the BMC dedicated port. Unplugging/replugging the dedicated-port cable is physical work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator connects/removes/replugs the BMC dedicated port and confirms network+MAC stay consistent; agent could only read `ipmitool lan print` after operator cabling changes.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO correctly preserves physical recabling, but does not resolve how a removed dedicated link can still provide BMC network operation or distinguish retained configuration from live traffic on an alternate interface.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED correctly identifies the missing alternate-path/disconnected-state contract and is retained because the ambiguity changes the meaning of both success and failure.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 825/2291 repeats physical-only handling without semantic validation, path attribution, independent observation or use of the source Script reference.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-989 draft was inspected only as history; this review independently retains the conflict conclusion and adds Script provenance, failover/failback identity and one-bound-channel acceptance.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 separates ordinary readiness inputs from permanent blocks, but ED-36 forbids reducing the dedicated-link functional objective. The removed-state path is a core target/operation contradiction and requires engineering correction.

original_test_intent: Validate the BMC dedicated-NIC physical path, one-bound-channel behavior, MAC/IP configuration and network operation across connected, physically removed and reconnected cable states.
original_method: A qualified operator changes the actual dedicated-port cable state while an independent surviving observation path records switch/PHY link, WebUI/IPMI channel and MAC/IP configuration, fresh client transactions and any approved alternate-interface failover/failback. The source does not define such an alternate path while the dedicated cable is absent.
manual_activity: Do not execute yet. After engineering aligns the path semantics and reviews the referenced script, a qualified operator traces/connects/removes/reconnects the dedicated cable and restores it. Automation may then collect per-state path, channel, identity and recovery evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative dedicated-port and any shared/failover interface topology, cable/switch/VLAN map, IPMI channel binding and which observer survives removal
Explicit state matrix distinguishing saved MAC/IP configuration, physical link, active bound channel and remote reachability for connected, removed and reconnected states
Meaning of `only one Bounded LAN channel`, whether and how channel/interface rebinding occurs, and expected failover/failback timing without duplicate simultaneous paths
Approved static/DHCP address behavior, lease identity and whether MAC/IP persist or move when an alternate path activates
Reviewed immutable revision of the internal dedicated-nic Script and mapping of its actions/assertions to the corrected acceptance matrix
Dedicated SUT, maintenance window, local/alternate recovery, protected credentials, physical procedure and stop conditions
safety_requirements: Do not remove the dedicated management cable until engineering defines expected loss or a named alternate path and confirms a local/OOB recovery route.
Trace chassis port, cable, switch port, VLAN, BMC interface/channel and MAC before removal. Prevent loops, duplicate IPs and accidental disturbance of the shared/host or production network.
Do not treat cached `lan print`/WebUI values as live reachability; require independent physical-link evidence and a fresh authenticated transaction attributed to the active path.
Do not assume any response after dedicated-link removal traveled over the dedicated path. Prove the egress/ingress interface, active channel and switch port.
The internal Script URL is preserved but was not accessible for this review; do not execute or trust an unknown mutable script revision until its content, hash, parameters and recovery are reviewed.

Do not automatically retry cable cycles or network operations. Stop on wrong target/path, loop/storm, duplicate address, unexpected binding, BMC loss or failed failback; reconnect/secure the cable and restore the approved state.
agent_execution_scope: Before an engineer decision, only analyze the topology/acceptance contradiction and request a reviewed immutable Script revision; do not touch DUT or network state.
After approval, collect per-state switch/PHY, active interface/channel, MAC/IP/lease, route/neighbor and fresh authenticated BMC transaction evidence with exact timestamps.
Measure failover and failback only if explicitly in scope and attribute every response to the named physical path.
Do not recable, execute an unreviewed script, retry automatically or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Decide whether cable removal expects dedicated-path loss or failover through a named interface and define one-bound-channel/MAC/IP behavior in each state.
Review and pin the internal Script revision against the corrected method, including safety and recovery.
Approve and perform the physical workflow, restore dedicated operation and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its non-runnable physical boundary is correct but incomplete. An IPMI query cannot run through a cable that was just removed unless a separately defined path survives, and the source's internal Script was not available to establish that path.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution is recommended until engineering defines the removed-state semantics and reviews the referenced Script. Afterwards use vendor-validated, path-bound channel and reachability probes with protected credentials and an independent observer.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Connect/remove/replug, WebUI/IPMI, one bound channel, three-scenario Criteria, Script URL and 10/10-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Approve a physical path/channel/address state matrix and pinned Script revision; baseline the dedicated path; remove it under independent observation; verify expected loss or named failover; reconnect; verify deterministic failback and stable original service.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Engineer-approved dedicated BMC NIC plus any explicitly named shared/failover path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, NIC/NC-SI, CPLD, switch, DHCP and Script revision/hash.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform dedicated-NIC and failover/binding specification plus reviewed internal dedicated-nic Script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the missing observer/alternate path, active-channel attribution, failover/failback timing and immutable Script review.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A response through shared NIC cannot prove dedicated-link operation; retained MAC/IP text cannot prove live reachability; reconnection without failback evidence cannot prove restored binding.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Engineer path/state decision, Script content/hash, topology, timers, evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Removing the only defined management link can strand the BMC; unexplained alternate connectivity can produce a false PASS.

project_override_considerations: A Project Override may explicitly require shared-NIC failover when the dedicated link is absent, but must record the original dedicated-port wording, actual path/channel behavior, approval, equivalence and any unverified dedicated-link coverage.
expected_evidence: Engineer-approved dedicated/alternate topology and corrected connected/removed/reconnected state matrix
Pinned internal Script content/revision/hash and review mapping, or documented manual replacement with coverage difference
Per-state physical cable and switch/PHY link evidence with active interface/channel/MAC/IP/lease attribution
Fresh client reachability and authenticated BMC transactions through the proved path, including expected loss or failover timing
Reconnection/failback timeline, stable final dedicated service, no duplicate/loop/unexpected binding, retained logs and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure removes the named dedicated BMC cable yet still asks WebUI/IPMI to check the BMC network, while Criteria require operation in all three states without defining a shared/alternate observation path or whether the removed state should instead be unreachable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing path is a core target and acceptance contradiction: success after removal could be correct failover or proof that the wrong path was tested, while failure could be expected physical behavior or a defect. The inaccessible Script reference cannot be assumed to resolve this. Engineering must define the state semantics first.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its physical boundary but adds the missing path and acceptance decision.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with BLOCKED and strengthens Script, one-channel and failback requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds semantic sanity, path attribution and automated evidence after the manual action.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms the conflict while adding immutable Script provenance and recovery detail.

review_improvement: Prevents traffic over a shared or cached path from masquerading as dedicated-NIC success and prevents an inaccessible internal Script from being treated as validated test logic.
independent_technical_reasoning: A dedicated physical link cannot carry traffic while unplugged. Any continued management response necessarily uses another interface or observation mechanism, so the active path and expected rebinding must be part of the acceptance contract. Without that contract, neither success nor failure has a stable engineering meaning.
